claims.statement: Market regime strongly stratifies recycling outcomes in validation: NO_RECOVERY share is 22.7% (M_STRONG) / 32.8% (M_NEUTRAL) / 67.2% (M_WEAK); the confirmation pattern is flatter (23.1/15.2/23.5%) — regime-conditioned outcome structure is segment-dependent

Direct answer to the T6.4 core question: WITHIN the hot-REDUCE signature subset (ret_1d>0 AND efficiency>0 at R0, the T6.3 C302 false-recovery signature carriers), market regime does NOT separate true from false recovery — FR rate by regime: val 50.2/49.0/49.0% and conf 54.4/46.1/57.0%, all pairwise CIs cross zero (SvW p=0.717 val, 0.551 conf). The separating condition for same-signature recoveries is NOT the external PIT market state
claims.evidence: A2 hot_subset blocks with CIs and SvW contrasts

claims.statement: Across ALL recovered cycles (unrestricted), the false-recovery rate is HIGHER in M_STRONG than M_WEAK in validation (+7.4pp, Holm-significant) but the contrast reverses insignificantly in confirmation (-2.5pp, p=0.215); because the contrast vanishes inside the hot subset, the validation effect is consistent with a composition effect (which cycles enter the recovered pool in strong markets), not with regime adding separating information per cycle
claims.evidence: A2 all_recovered vs hot_subset blocks; Holm within family (only val all_recovered SvW survives)

claims.statement: The T6.1 E-class risk-shaping structure is regime-UNIFORM: E3's abs_mdd advantage and lower terminal-failure rate hold in ALL THREE market regimes in BOTH segments (e.g. val abs_mdd E3 vs E1: 0.047/0.051/0.033 vs 0.066/0.061/0.050; conf p_terminal_failure E3 0.483/0.457/0.580 vs E1 0.614/0.537/0.682) — the E mapping's risk structure is not a market-state artifact
claims.evidence: A3_eclass_by_regime, all regime strata, both primary segments

claims.statement: The C106 E2 tension concentrates in weak markets: E2 terminal-failure excess over E1 is largest in M_WEAK (val 54.3% vs 49.8%; conf 71.9% vs 68.2%) and smallest in M_STRONG (conf 62.6% vs 61.4%) — the carried-to-the-end drawdown pattern of E2 is regime-amplified
claims.evidence: A3 p_terminal_failure by E x regime
